exercise.name: Decline Dumbbell Skull Crusher
steps: Lie on a decline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms straight up.
Bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Straighten your arms again, keeping your elbows pointing up.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying on a 20 deg decline bench, feet hooked, a dumbbell in each hand. Upper arms point straight up and stay still; the elbows bend ~110 deg to lower the dumbbells beside the head, then straighten. Triceps are the target.

setup.target: Pad tilted 20 deg, high end 0.80 m, the head end lower than the feet.
setup.why: Library step 1: feet hooked under the pads of a decline bench; the slope makes the trunk lift against more of gravity than on the floor.

setup.target: Knees over the knee roll, ankles under the front roller.
setup.why: Holds the body on the sloped pad.
S3: triceps EMG does not change with bench angle, so the decline keeps the same triceps work.

setup.target: Upper arms straight up to the ceiling, neutral grip.
setup.tolerance: upper arm within 10 deg of vertical
setup.why: Library step 1; elbows pointing up keeps the work at the elbow.

movement.path: Still; elbows keep pointing up (library step 3).

muscles.emg: Lying triceps extension 62% of the triangle push-up (S1); triceps EMG unchanged by bench angle (S3).
muscles.surface: Back of the upper arm, shoulder to elbow.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Upper arms swing down as the weights lower.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Shoulders take the work (it becomes a pull-over).

sources.citation: Boehler B, Porcari JP, Kline D, Hendrix CR, Foster C, Anders M. 2011. ACE-sponsored research: best triceps exercises. ACE Certified News, August 2011.
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps EMG vs the triangle push-up (100%): kickback 87%, dips 87%, overhead extension 76%, lying barbell extension 62%.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250. doi:10.1080/17461391.2022.2100279
sources.what_it_gave: Elbow extension 90-0 deg with the arm overhead stretches the long head and grew the triceps 1.4-1.5x more than with the arm at the side.

sources.citation: Rodriguez-Ridao D, Antequera-Vique JA, Martin-Fuentes I, Muyor JM. 2020. Effect of five bench inclinations on the electromyographic activity of the pectoralis major, anterior deltoid, and triceps brachii during the bench press exercise. Int J Environ Res Public Health 17(19):7339. doi:10.3390/ijerph17197339
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps EMG similar at every bench angle (0-60 deg): tilting the bench does not change the triceps' work.
The steps the app shows; the pictures must match them.

clip_check.check: End: dumbbells beside the head, not hitting it
Feet hooked, back on the pad
